steps.comment: OPTIONAL: client certificate usage monitoring - one audit line per successful Gateway logon with a client certificate, to a remote syslog listener
steps.note: EXAMPLE only, to show the automation. Run after 04-gateway.json and 08-mtls-client-ca.json. Adds its own syslog action and a global syslog policy NEXT TO existing logging (nothing is replaced). Changes no authentication, mTLS or CRL setting: the rewrite policy is NOREWRITE with goto NEXT. The listener and the parsing side are in pki-monitoring (docs/netscaler-cert-usage.md). See docs/monitoring.md.

steps.comment: Remote syslog destination: TCP, INFORMATIONAL only, user-defined audit messages on
steps.note: Plain TCP syslog: no encryption, no sender authentication - send it only to a listener on a trusted network that accepts the NSIPs only. Do NOT raise the level to DEBUG for this: DEBUG also sends AAA/OAuth internals (authorization codes).
Global binding next to the existing ones (other priority). The journal removes only this binding (DELETE ?args=policyname:slp_monitoring).

steps.comment: Certificate usage line for ONE Gateway: written when the Gateway sends the StoreFront logon of an authenticated session
steps.note: The Gateway name is a literal on purpose (CLIENT.IP.DST is the StoreFront back end on this request). Never add AAA.USER.ATTRIBUTE("accesstoken") or any other token. Copy the next three steps per Gateway to monitor. idp_upn needs an IdP action that extracts a 'upn' attribute; it stays empty otherwise.

data.name: ma_cert_usage_gw_example_com
data.stringbuilderexpr: "NSMON|v1|gateway_logon|gateway=gw_example_com|client_ip=" + CLIENT.IP.SRC + "|cert_serial=" + CLIENT.SSL.CLIENT_CERT.SERIALNUMBER + "|cert_issuer=" + CLIENT.SSL.CLIENT_CERT.ISSUER + "|cert_subject=" + CLIENT.SSL.CLIENT_CERT.SUBJECT + "|aaa_user=" + AAA.USER.NAME + "|idp_upn=" + AAA.USER.ATTRIBUTE("upn")

data.name: rw_pol_cert_usage_gw_example_com
data.comment: certificate usage audit line only - changes nothing

steps.note: Priority below the Gateway's own REQUEST rewrite policies, goto NEXT: they still run. Pick a free priority if 90 is taken.
